details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_inject_token_into_url (lines 3041-3052), _resolve_origin_url (lines 3077-3087), removed scoped-header auth in _git_subprocess_env (lines 2987-2992) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Memory git operations embed GH_TOKEN/GH_PAT directly into HTTPS URLs instead of using per-process http.extraHeader authentication.
  WHY: Tokens become visible in process arguments, git diagnostics, and temporary `.git/config` remotes, violating the repository's credential-isolation contract.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:_memory_force_tick_remote_url (lines 578-588) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_force_tick_remote_url` embeds the token in URLs used by memory `git` operations.
  WHY: The credential is exposed in `/proc/<pid>/cmdline`, git errors, logs, and temporary remote configuration.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:is_sensitive_target_path deleted (was at lines 152-167); normalize_path (lines 240-247); emit_context (lines 536-716) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering was removed, allowing untrusted target paths such as `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh`, and `.aws` files to be read into model prompts.
  WHY: Adversarial issue or plan input can expose repository credentials and metadata to the model or prompt artifacts.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: line 668 (final `codex exec ... --sandbox danger-full-access`) plus the deleted broker lifecycle calls that used to wrap this invocation (lines 212-222) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Diagnose runs issue-derived diagnostic content through unrestricted Codex execution with `GH_TOKEN` and `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` available, after removing the broker boundary.
  WHY: Prompt injection can exfiltrate credentials or mutate the workspace; the severity disagreement is none.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: file ends at line ~140 after the model_provider_broker_* family (start / stop / prepare_codex_writer / prepare_codex_readonly / exec_sanitized / exec_unprivileged / grant_read_path / capture_acl) is deleted | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The model-provider broker functions were deleted while live workflows and scripts still invoke them.
  WHY: Codex phases abort with `command not found`, and the credential-isolation boundary is lost.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: scripts/codex_helpers.sh lines 65-96 (--provider-base-url parsing removed); scripts/write_codex_config.sh lines 85-110 (--provider-base-url usage + parsing removed), line 261 (hardcoded `base_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1") | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed although callers still pass the broker URL, and the generated configuration hardcodes the public OpenRouter endpoint.
  WHY: Callers fail with `unknown argument: --provider-base-url`; accepted configurations would bypass the loopback broker.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: deleted block of `review_blocked_*` helpers at lines 947-… (decision_digest / find_pending_request / build_approval_request / approval_status / post_approval_request / post_consumed_marker / find_issue_for_request / build_successor_intent / successor_marker / ensure_successor_intent / resolve_successor_issue / prepare_successor_issue) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Review-blocked approval and successor-issue helpers were deleted while `review_rb_judge.sh` and `orchestrate_poll_process.sh` still invoke them.
  WHY: Review-blocked terminal actions cannot construct, verify, post, or consume approval state and the recovery path fails.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: git_with_github_auth (was at lines 493-507) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The authenticated git helper was deleted while judge-fix and reissue-baseline callers still invoke it.
  WHY: Those pushes fail against `persist-credentials: false` checkouts or fall through to unauthenticated remotes.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: REST jq transform at line 766-772; GraphQL query at lines 833-839; GraphQL jq transform at lines 913-924 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Normalized review comments no longer include `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, or `author_association`.
  WHY: Producer identity and approver authorization checks reject all approval requests, and comment-id mappings break.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: usage line 7; option parsing at lines 49-54; `CODEX_STALL_GUARD_PROCESS_GROUP_FILE` plumbing and `PROCESS_GROUP_FILE` env at lines 136, 165, 229-323, 367, 412-418, 435-462 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--process-group-file` and its process-group supervision were removed while `review_apply_fixes.sh` still passes the option.
  WHY: Isolated editor launches exit with `unknown option` before starting, and descendant cleanup metadata is unavailable.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:_kill_child_group_if_running at 290-303; child.poll() liveness instead of isolated-group membership | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The remaining guard tracks only the wrapper process after isolated-user process-group tracking and privileged cleanup were removed.
  WHY: `sudo -n -u nobody` descendants can survive the wrapper and retain workspace access.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context (lines 536-716) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The 256-path cap was removed and missing, binary, and overflow markers do not advance `used_bytes`.
  WHY: Large untrusted path lists can produce output far beyond `max_bytes` and the Codex stdin limit.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: lines 30, 37 (imports), lines 714, 716, 776, 779, 781 (usage) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Tests still import deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path`.
  WHY: Pytest collection fails with `ImportError` before targeted-context tests run.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: memory_ensure_branch (lines 137-154, 177-185) and the force-tick clone/push call sites (lines ~767, 883, 919) | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Memory git operations became bare `git` commands after `_memory_git` was removed, while credentials remain step-local in `issue_pr_status.yml`.
  WHY: Later memory steps use unauthenticated HTTPS remotes, silently losing branch initialization and memory writes.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: "Configure git auth for memory helper clones" at lines 68-81 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `GIT_CONFIG_*` authentication exports exist only in one workflow step and are not inherited by later memory-helper steps.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, subsequent memory operations have no authentication.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: staged-support restore block (lines 101-237) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore block requires `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` and `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, but no workflow or script creates or exports them.
  WHY: The safeguard is inert and self-repo implementation can still overwrite branch-owned helpers with staged copies.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: `git merge-file` invocation at lines 204-207 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The reviewers report that `git merge-file -p -L editor -L "staged" -L HEAD -- editor staged head` uses the wrong current/other/base ordering.
  WHY: They conclude three-way merges can drop branch or editor hunks; moonshotai_kimi-k3 explicitly disagrees and states that the existing CLI order is correct, so severity is retained at the highest reported level.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 26-31, 127-132, 331-351, 367-372, 412-418, 435-462 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When `python3` is missing, the wrapper warns and exits without spawning the child instead of using the prior fallback.
  WHY: A self-hosted runner without Python can wait for a child that was never started.
- scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh: new staged-support branch (lines 5-76), Telegram send at lines 57-68 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new critical alert posts directly with `curl` and places `TG_BOT_SECRET` in the command line instead of using `tg_helpers.sh::tg_send_msg`.
  WHY: The secret can enter process arguments or shell tracing and the staged Telegram helper contract is bypassed.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
